title: Bar Drop Blueberry Cotton Candy 10ml Nic Salts E-Liquid
description: Bar Drop Salts Blueberry Cotton Candy by Drop offers a whimsical blend of fruit and fairground nostalgia. The flavour opens with the authentic, juicy taste of ripe blueberries, grounding the profile in natural fruitiness. This is enveloped by a fluffy, spun-sugar sweetness on the exhale, recreating the airy texture and taste of classic cotton candy. With its 40% VG / 60% PG ratio, this e-liquid avoids the muted flavour sometimes found in high-VG blends, ensuring the sugary cotton candy notes are punchy and clear. Designed for MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) hardware, the salt nicotine formulation delivers a smooth inhale in 5mg, 10mg, and 20mg strengths. Bar Drop Salts are brought to you by Drop and are manufactured right here in the UK. Drop’s collections focus on fabulously fruity flavours that are achingly authentic and blend familiar favourites with unique profiles.
